# Infracost PR analysis - ILLUSTRATIVE (not generated by the Infracost CLI)
Infracost needs an API key and network access, which were unavailable here. The figures below are hand-calculated from approximate us-east-1
on-demand prices (m5.large $0.096/h, m5.xlarge $0.192/h, db.t3.medium ~$0.068/h, EBS gp3 $0.08/GB-mo, 730 h/month). **Re-run `infracost diff` to produce the real output.**

```
Project: terraform  |  PR: "Upsize app instances m5.large -> m5.xlarge"
 Name                      Monthly Qty   Before     After      Diff
 aws_instance.app[*] (x2)  1,460 h       $140.16    $280.32    +$140.16
 aws_instance.app root vol 100 GB        $8.00      $8.00      $0
 aws_db_instance.main      730 h + 100GB $59.64     $59.64     $0
 aws_s3_bucket.logs        usage-based   -          -          -
 TOTAL                                   $207.80    $347.96    +$140.16 (+67%)
```
Policy suggestion: fail the PR check when monthly delta > $200 or > 20% without a FinOps approval label.
